title: Hamdard Dawakhana (Wakf) Lal Kuan, Delhi v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Hamdard Dawakhana (Wakf) Lal Kuan, Delhi v. Union of India, (1960) 2 SCR 671
content.facts: A statutory provision conferred power to add matters to a prohibited category without adequate legislative guidance.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether unguided executive power amounted to excessive delegation.
content.ratioDecidendi: A delegation lacking adequate legislative policy or guidance is impermissible.
content.relevance: Use for the requirement of policy, standards and guidance in delegated legislation.
